title: The Niche for Lights
author: Al-Ghazali (Gairdner trans)
description: Al-Ghazali interprets the Qur'anic imagery of light as a way of understanding perception, knowledge and divine reality. The work connects spiritual insight with a philosophical account of the degrees of illumination.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/mishkatalanwar0000gair).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
